Previous lessons:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress checklists/carousels, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns won.
Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, path activation incentives, interactive sound/visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners or spotlight/video flows hurt performance.
No clear effect seen: Audio/background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators/overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-adoption waiting auth reorders, and wait progress checklists performed better than predicted.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, split-view story intros, and all tests resulting in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, pre-upload inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress tip carousels and setup checklists, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, post-waiting auth reorders, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns significantly improved performance.

Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, instant path activation incentives, interactive sound and visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners, spotlight flows, or video cards hurt conversion.

No clear effect seen: Audio or background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators or overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-waiting auth stage reorders, and wait progress checklists or tip carousels performed better than expected.

Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, split-view story intros, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, and all tests that resulted in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.
